# Google DeepMind

> Google DeepMind develops cutting-edge AI systems including multimodal foundation models, scientific discovery tools, and responsible AI frameworks.

Google DeepMind is a leading AI research organization creating advanced AI models and systems across language, vision, audio, video, music, and robotics. The site showcases both foundational research breakthroughs and practical AI applications for scientific discovery and creative tasks.

## Key Topics

- Gemini
- Generative AI
- Multimodal AI
- Language Models
- Image Generation
- Video Generation
- Music Generation
- Robotics
- AlphaFold
- AlphaGo
- World Models
- AI Safety
- Responsible AI
- AI Research
- Foundation Models

## AI Models & Products

- [Models](https://deepmind.google/models): Catalog of DeepMind's AI models including Gemini, Lyria, and Veo
- [Gemini 3](https://deepmind.google/models/gemini): Advanced reasoning language model with multiple variants
- [Gemini Image – Nano Banana](https://deepmind.google/models/gemini-image): State-of-the-art image generation and editing with Nano Banana
- [Gemini Audio](https://deepmind.google/models/gemini-audio): Advanced real-time audio models for speech and conversation
- [Veo 3](https://deepmind.google/models/veo): State-of-the-art video generation model for filmmaking
- [Imagen 4](https://deepmind.google/models/imagen): Photorealistic text-to-image generation model
- [Lyria 3](https://deepmind.google/models/lyria): Advanced music generation and composition model
- [Gemma](https://deepmind.google/models/gemma): Lightweight open-source models for on-device AI

## Scientific Discovery & AI Systems

- [Science](https://deepmind.google/science): AI applications for scientific discovery and research
- [AlphaFold](https://deepmind.google/science/alphafold): Protein structure prediction revolutionizing biology
- [AlphaGenome: AI for Better Understanding the Genome](https://deepmind.google/blog/alphagenome-ai-for-better-understanding-the-genome): DNA sequence model for genome analysis
- [AlphaGo](https://deepmind.google/research/alphago): Landmark AI system that mastered the game of Go
- [Genie 3](https://deepmind.google/models/genie): World model generating photorealistic 3D environments
- [SIMA 2: AI Agent for 3D Virtual Worlds](https://deepmind.google/blog/sima-2-an-agent-that-plays-reasons-and-learns-with-you-in-virtual-3d-worlds): Gemini-powered AI agent for 3D virtual worlds

## Robotics & Embodied AI

- [Gemini Robotics](https://deepmind.google/models/gemini-robotics): Multimodal models for robot control and agents

## Research & Evaluation

- [Research](https://deepmind.google/research): DeepMind's AI research overview and breakthroughs
- [Publications](https://deepmind.google/research/publications): DeepMind's research publications on AI and machine learning
- [Evals](https://deepmind.google/research/evals): AI evaluation benchmarks and factuality assessment tools

## Responsibility & Safety

- [Responsibility & Safety](https://deepmind.google/responsibility-and-safety): AI safety, ethics, and responsible development practices
